import { type TemplateResult } from 'lit';
import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export interface AccordionItem {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    content: string | TemplateResult;
}
export declare class Accordion extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        items: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        openIds: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        defaultOpenIds: {
            attribute: boolean;
        };
        multiple: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
        variant: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
    };
    items: readonly AccordionItem[];
    openIds: readonly string[] | undefined;
    defaultOpenIds: readonly string[] | undefined;
    multiple: boolean;
    variant: string;
    private state;
    constructor();
    get committedIds(): readonly string[];
    private toggle;
    willUpdate(): void;
    render(): TemplateResult<1>;
}
